content.text: Base ring plus two courses of piers, tan on a dark grey foundation.
Arch lintels over every opening, then the dark-tan ledge ring.
Upper set-back tier with small openings, corner buttresses, and the cornice cap.
Tying the corner buttresses to the walls with cornice plates.
